correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the ordinary complex by nontrivial cuts in four-vertex sets. A separate set-based enumeration and depth-first acyclicity test reproduced (10,45,120,210,240,140), 3330 Hasse incidences, 369 disjoint pairs and exactly one critical vertex and 26 critical facets. Forman's theorem then gives the actual wedge, not just mod-two Betti numbers: the five-cells all attach to the sole zero-cell. Enumeration confirms the five stars are all independent 4-sets and there is no independent 5-set; intersecting stars recovers every vertex, so the label action is the full group. For a fixed face that is a union of k vertex cycles, oriented alternating trace has sign (-1)^(k-1). This independently gives top traces (26,6,-2,2,0,0,1). The characters of the standard, the two-subset permutation module minus the point permutation module, and the exterior square of the standard identify [41], [32], [311] and verify the stated multiplicities. Barycentric face flags have pointwise stabilizers when preserved setwise; quotient chains are the coinvariants, an exact functor over Q by averaging, yielding the stated top rank and no other reduced rational homology.
